question: Why is reinterpretation through Shiva-tattva insufficient without proper preparation?
premises: One may grant a limited reinterpretation of other systems through Shiva-tattva.
That does not mean the full expansion of Shiva-tattva is present there.
Knowledge of Shiva-tattva must be preceded by the appropriate preparation.
inference: Without the requisite preparation, other systems cannot yield full knowledge of Shiva-tattva.
plain_english: Let that be granted to that extent; but the full expansion is not there. It has been examined that knowledge of the Shiva principle must be preceded by the proper preparation.
